profile.headline: Sr. Staff Engineer at Slack
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Senior Staff Software Engineer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States
positions.description: Work on an internal team, creating tools and improving frameworks so Slack backend devs can ship performant and reliable code. Created Hakana (http://github.com/slackhq/hakana) to quickly identify bugs & security vulnerabilities in a very large (10MLOC) codebase.

positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Principal Engineer, Developer Experience
positions.description: Started as a product engineer, ended as an infra engineer. Created a typechecker to catch coding mistakes (https://psalm.dev). Made unit tests 2x faster (with https://github.com/vimeo/php-mysql-engine). Rewrote a ton of code so developers could ship features faster and safer. Helped scale the platform through pandemic traffic peaks.

positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States

positions.title: Software Engineer & more
positions.description: Built a website & web-based point-of-sale system that talked to an inventory management system (that I also built). Also did a bit of product photography.

positions.title: Choral singer
positions.locationName: New York, New York, United States · On-site
positions.description:
Full-time member of a world-renowned choral ensemble
Involved singing five choral services a week + concerts & recordings

positions.title: Choral singer
positions.description:
Singing, helping with rehearsals, and general administration of a 100-person choir program.

Wrote a lot of software to help keep the program going:

 - a library management tool
 - a CRM for choir members
 - also created lots of one-off fundraising microsites
